title: Oxygen and the O2 signature
slide_intent: Use a familiar visual ingredient to introduce a name so viewers connect movement with the identity.
strategic_value: The soft bubbles and blue mark can reconnect O2’s digital identity with its oxygen premise.
demonstration: Translucent pale-blue bubbles cross a white field before a centered blue O2 mark appears; the bubbles then clear away.
practical_value: Give the signature a clear resting state after an atmospheric entrance.

content_islands.name: Bubble field
content_islands.spec: Let softly shaded bubbles enter and cross the white field, with some cropped at the edges.

content_islands.name: Signature reveal
content_islands.spec: Place the blue O2 mark centrally and retain it as the surrounding bubbles leave.

ingredient.name: Oxygen bubbles
ingredient.role: Make the oxygen premise visible as a light, moving atmosphere.
ingredient.application: In this reveal, move bubbles across a white field and leave a clear centered mark at the end.
ingredient.scope: Observed opening animation in the 2023 refresh case study; no universal timing or easing rule is supplied.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying introduction says the refresh restores purpose to oxygen through the bubble, color and typography for a digital-first future.
reference_purposes.Expression: Soft translucent bubbles and the blue O2 signature form the clip’s recognizable visual language.
